name: captain-finance-wlt
objective: Close Captain financial readback so COD custody and personal commission lifecycle come only from WLT-backed canonical truth, with no Captain-side financial mutation.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns COD financial liability, commission policy/calculation/lifecycle, wallet/ledger/adjustments; DSH may proxy bounded authorized references only.

tasks.objective: Preserve and prove Captain COD custody truth
tasks.currentProblem: Current Captain finance bridge reads WLT-owned COD through a governed DSH Captain proxy; this needs actor isolation, state/idempotency and reconciliation evidence.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace COD record creation/collection/remittance readback from DSH operational evidence to WLT persistence and Captain-scoped proxy; fix drift without moving financial truth into DSH.
tasks.targetState: Captain sees only own canonical COD liability and status; retries/readbacks are consistent and finance operator can reconcile authoritative WLT records.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate authoritative COD balance in DSH/frontend.
Do not allow cross-Captain COD reads.
Do not treat a DSH operational status as settled financial truth without WLT readback.
Do not bypass or regress the reconciled WLT daily finance close, settlement-batch freeze/export, or manual-evidence controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Captain COD list/outstanding amount derives from scoped WLT records.
Collection/remittance transitions are idempotent/auditable and reconcile to ledger rules where applicable.
Error/offline/empty states never fabricate zero liability.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U006 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.

tasks.objective: Implement missing Captain commission lifecycle readback
tasks.currentProblem: Product Truth requires app-captain to list own pending/confirmed/settled/rejected/reversed commissions and adjustment reasons, but WltDshCaptainBridge explicitly reports aggregate Captain earnings unavailable and current settlement reference is partner-oriented.
tasks.requiredChange: Implement the WLT-owned Captain-scoped commission list/read model and bounded DSH/application adapter required by Product Truth; replace unavailable earnings copy with canonical lifecycle readback. Do not create a Captain settlement request/mutation unless a separate Product Truth authorizes it.
tasks.targetState: Captain finance renders own commission lifecycle and adjustment reasons from WLT; 'settled' is a commission state, not a frontend-calculated payout or unauthorized Captain settlement action.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not accept commission amounts from Captain or DSH as truth.
Do not add Captain confirm/settle/reject/reverse controls.
Do not reuse partnerId settlement APIs as a Captain settlement source of truth.
Do not route Captain commission readback through the operator daily-close/batch mutation endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Captain sees own commission states required by Product Truth with canonical WLT amounts/policy/adjustment reasons.
Another Captain's commission data is inaccessible.
Finance mutations remain operator/service-authenticated, idempotent, audited and WLT-owned.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U006 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.
